reason: The report uses a bivariate regression with no controls, so it omits the pre-period outcome (export_growth_2020) and the other 2020 covariates. It also trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome, so it does not use the full sample. When I add the pre-period controls, the coefficient falls from about 2.2–2.6 to about 0.6–0.7, so the reported 2.229 is heavily confounded and overstated. No control variable was measured after treatment.
